profile.headline: Virtual Adventurer | Collaborative Software Developer | Capoeirista
profile.summary:
Software Engineer who enjoys turning data into decisions.

Technical Skills
•	Languages:  Python, Java, MySQL, C#
•	Platforms:  AWS, Apache Airflow, VMware vRealize Automation
•	Data:  ELT, Snowflake
•	Version Controls:  Git, GitHub, Bitbucket 
•	Testing Tools:  Smoke testing, JUnit, PyUnit, NUnit
•	Frameworks:  Spring Boot, .NET
•	IDE:  VS Code, IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, Visual Studio


Belief | Connected | Harmony | Developer | Discipline

positions.title: Software Engineer - Remote
positions.description: Data engineering (ETL) and custom software engineering within the Applied Intelligence and Cloud Engineering Capabilities

positions.title: Data Analyst
positions.description:
+ Contributed in the Optimization Team to increases efficiency of SigerTax Database and departmental processes
+ Conducted national and international property value research 
+ Communicated with tax authorities and with in-house technical team
+ Utilized SigerTax, CRM, AdVolution Database,  and Excel for data management
+ Served as a Culture Ambassador to provide and preserve an environment that boosts team relationships

positions.title: Land Administrator
positions.description:
+ Helped close $946 Million sale through due diligence and following up with lessors 
+ Interpreted and applied contract requirements of communicating sale of ownership
+ Set up contracts within industry-specific systems, such as SharePoint and Quorum
+ Oversaw quality control of over 400 contract and lease files daily
+ Hired on after proving ability while working with Leading Edge Personnel

positions.title: Office Administrator
positions.description:
+ Communicate with over 20 suppliers via email each day to gather required documentation
+ Maintain confidential files via data entry in preparation for government audit 
+ Answer phone lines, set up appointments, and prepare over 30 orders for processing daily 
+ Compile documents into over 10 books to begin production daily

positions.title: Business Consultant
positions.description:
+ Coordinated front of house operations to increase guest satisfaction by 10% 
+ Interviewed and trained 6 front of house employees to provide quality customer service
+ Collaborated with management to establish policies, procedures, and training manual 
+ Developed job descriptions to increase accuracy of responsibility and evaluation

positions.title: Cashier Associate
positions.description:
+ Requested by management to train 2 new cashier associates 
+ Collaborated with sales team to meet monthly targets using suggestive selling to fit guest needs 
+ Oversaw Point of Sale System for over 50 transactions in daily high volume atmosphere 
+ Served as director of first impressions and point of conflict resolution

positions.title: Alumni Relations Coordinator
positions.description:
+ Doubled alumni relation by building strong relationships
+ Increased accuracy of database using multi-channel media
+ Led and motivated a team of 5 to create ways to connect with alumni 
+ Served on Board of Executives to ensure needs of the chapter are met
+ Oversaw financial budget and hosted 2 banquets, 2 ceremonies, and various events

company.name: Phi Sigma Pi National Honor Fraternity

positions.title: Administrative Assistant
positions.description:
+ Maintained knowledge of fiscal services billing and charge procedures
+ Utilized service desk, phone, chat, and email to answer questions of aviation and operational conditions 
+ Assisted in maintenance and oversight of aviation collections, equipment, and facilities

educations.schoolName: The University of Texas at San Antonio

volunteerExperiences.description:
Hosted Toys for Tots Foundation
Hosted Cancer Walkathons
Hosted Quarterly Clothes and Food Can Drives
Visited Women's Shelters and Nursing Home
